The '''2nd [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best achievements in [[1944 in film|1944 filmmaking]], were announced in February 1945 and held on April 16, 1945, at [[The Beverly Hills Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref name="Ceremony">{{cite magazine |title=Foreign press men vote honors to ''Way'' |date=April 17, 1945 |magazine=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |volume=83 |issue=10 |page=3 |id={{ProQuest|2320433827}}}}</ref><ref>{{cite magazine |title=Foreign writers honor ''Way'', Knox |date=February 27, 1945 |magazine=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |volume=82 |issue=25 |page=6 |id={{ProQuest|2320433827}}}}</ref>

==Winners==
The 2nd Golden Globe Awards were presented on April 16, 1945, during a dinner in the Terrace Room of [[The Beverly Hills Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]]. [[B.G. DeSylva]] accepted the [[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Picture]] award.<ref name="Ceremony"/>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Picture]]===
* ''[[Going My Way]]'' directed by [[Leo McCarey]]

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Actor in a Leading Role]]===
* [[Alexander Knox]] – ''[[Wilson (1944 film)|Wilson]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Actress in a Leading Role]]===
* [[Ingrid Bergman]] – ''[[Gaslight (1944 film)|Gaslight]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
* [[Barry Fitzgerald]] – ''Going My Way''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
* [[Agnes Moorehead]] – ''[[Mrs. Parkington]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Director – Motion Picture]]===
* [[Leo McCarey]] – ''Going My Way''
